tutor_message.content:
Great! To structure your approach, here’s a breakdown you can follow:

1. Identify that for each element (except the last), you need to determine the maximum value among all the elements to its right.
2. Recognize a naive approach would loop through each element and search to its right, but that can be inefficient for large arrays.
3. Consider starting from the end of the array and keeping track of the maximum value you have seen so far as you move left.
4. Update each position with this maximum value, and handle the last element by setting it to -1 according to the problem statement.

Work through each substep systematically—set up your loop, manage the current maximum, and update the array as you traverse it.
